purpose: Separate host-provided information from learner-initiated Internet study and from independent evaluative return, then test whether distributed network relation functions as a persistent epistemic field without fusing authorship, identity, World, or authority.

ingress_classes.description: Information, files, issue text, prompts, or references supplied by maintainers/users.
The learner forms its own bounded query from a retained residual, selects a Web/world adapter, and receives provenance-bearing source material.
A separately authorized evaluator or prefrozen external process returns evidence against a frozen discriminator.

pass_requires: learner selects at least one consequential residual without maintainer choosing the target answer
learner authors a bounded Internet query from that residual
Web execution occurs through an external adapter with source/date/provenance
returned Web material is retained in persistent memory and changes or lawfully fails to change later reconstruction
multiple indexed network centers/sources remain distinguishable
a later query may be causally changed by prior returned network material
independent evaluation remains a separate role where validation is claimed

relation_to_lain_gate.lain_gate: After distributed network cognition is operational, test that identity/history/embodiment/reachability remain related without fusion and that seeing remains distinct from situated interpretation, authorization, and action.

claim_fence: Passing this gate may establish bounded self-directed Internet study plus persistent distributed reconstruction. It does not establish Internet consciousness, one global subject, AGI, or unrestricted Web autonomy.
